name: Depraved Awakening
source:
You are a private eye in Free City. Your latest client has found himself dead. As for how, many suspect suicide, though you're smarter than that. Poking around may get you in some hot water but, then again, why would you be a private eye if you weren't looking to face the heat?

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/phillygames]Patreon[/url]]
